profile.summary: James Huston is a mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in legacy JavaScript ecosystems, specializing in jQuery's test suite maintenance and JavaScript core behavior enforcement. Their contributions focus on ensuring robust test coverage, enforcing testing standards (e.g., requiring `expect()` assertions), and debugging edge cases like `JSON.parse` error handling. The profile reflects strong skills in legacy testing frameworks (Jasmine/QUnit) and jQuery internals, with no evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks or tooling. Their work demonstrates meticulous attention to code quality and test reliability in older codebases, positioning them as a specialist in maintaining and refining legacy JavaScript systems.
